messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] continuous-batch backlog spike detected on cluster inference-prod-usw2. 99p token latency jumped from 2.1s -> 9.8s across ~37 shards. auto-pager triggered.

devon: hitting this now, I'm on pager. seeing large KV cache eviction churn and microbatch sizes drifting up to 64 on some replicas (expected 8-16). queueing visible in tail logs.

sylvie: confirming - telemetry graphs show sustained batch depth increase + KV miss rate up x6. looks like prefetch loop causing cache thrash under high concurrency.

morgan: customer impact? any 5xxs or user-facing stalls?

devon: a subset of hosted customers experienced increased 502/504s for short windows, around 2-5% of requests in the affected region. slow tails only, p50 still ok. Notified SRE and CS.

ashok: can you dump a sample of kv eviction logs + batching metrics?

devon: pasted sample snippet from runtime logs:

```
[2026-03-15T09:12:02Z] shard=shard-12 microbatch_size=48 queue_len=312 kv_cache_evictions=1243 kv_cache_hits=987 kv_cache_misses=3210
[2026-03-15T09:12:07Z] shard=shard-12 microbatch_size=56 queue_len=410 prefetch_trigger=true prefetch_queue=94
[2026-03-15T09:12:14Z] shard=shard-12 microbatch_size=64 kv_cache_free_bytes=120MB target=512MB
```

opsbot: note: this looks like continuous-batching + aggressive prefetch combined with a lower-than-expected cache capacity on those instances.

tara: propose immediate mitigation: temporarily reduce CONT_BATCH_MAX_MICROBATCH and disable PREFETCH on the affected deployment pool. that should reduce queueing and give KV cache time to stabilize.

devon: +1. I'll prepare a hotpatch. plan: 1) set CONT_BATCH_MAX_MICROBATCH=8 2) set PREFETCH_ENABLED=false 3) roll to 20% canary for 2 mins then 100% if ok.

sylvie: also increase KV_CACHE_EVICTION_THRESHOLD to avoid aggressive churn? maybe bump from 0.6 -> 0.8 for now.

morgan: customer comms: we should create a short note describing degraded tail latency and that we're rolling a config hotpatch, ETA 15m. tagging cs@ for impacted customers.

devon: executing hotpatch now. command:

```
# canary env patch
kubectl set env deploy/inference-runtime CONT_BATCH_MAX_MICROBATCH=8 PREFETCH_ENABLED=false KV_CACHE_EVICT_THRESH=0.8 -n inference-prod-usw2 --selector=pool=continuous-highconcurrency
# annotate for rollback tracking
kubectl annotate deploy/inference-runtime rollout.hotpatch="cb-prefetch-evict-20260315" -n inference-prod-usw2
```

deploy-bot: rollout started: inference-runtime (pool=continuous-highconcurrency) -> canary 20%. link: https://deployments.redwood.internal/r/rollout/4865012345

devon: canary metrics after 60s: 99p latency dropped from 9.8s->3.4s on canary replicas, kv eviction rate down 70% on canary.

morgan: good signal. proceed with staged rollout. please keep 1-min checks on SLO dashboards.

ashok: also increasing autoscale buffer for that pool by +2 nodes to absorb burst while cache stabilizes.

opsbot: autoscale action queued: add 2 nodes -> pool continuous-highconcurrency.

sylvie: monitoring: 15m window shows progressive tail drop. still seeing a couple of hotspots (shard-7) - isolating now.

devon: rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: rollout 100% complete. rollout duration 7m. link: https://deployments.redwood.internal/r/rollout/4865012345/completed

tara: post-mortem quick note: root cause hypothesis - combination of increased concurrent request fanout + unchecked prefetch heuristics that scale microbatch size beyond safe limits for current KV cache capacity, leading to eviction storms and head-of-line queueing.

morgan: impact: short-duration degraded tail latency for hosted customers in us-west (approx 5% of requests had elevated tails for ~12m). no data loss. CS notified with customer list: cust-a, cust-b, cust-c.

ashok: followups: - add guardrail to throttle prefetch when kv eviction rate > X - surface per-shard microbatch cap telemetry in console - run replay tests with high concurrency + low cache to ensure stable behavior - consider defaulting CONT_BATCH_MAX_MICROBATCH to 16 instead of unlimited.

sylvie: owner for followups? ashok + tara on remediation. devon will write incident timeline and initial RCA.

devon: handing pager to sylvie for next shift. tl;dr: hotpatch reduced tail latencies, autoscale absorbed burst, followups assigned.

sylvie: ack takeover. I'll watch for reoccurrence and prep a short RCA draft for the incident channel.

oncall-bot: incident state -> mitigated. severity downgraded. creating incident ticket: INC-20260315-048.

morgan: thanks team. please add any noteworthy logs/snippets to the incident ticket and ping me if CS needs anything else.

opsbot: timed snapshot of metrics pinned: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/snapshots/4865012345

sylvie: closing this thread, moving detailed notes to INC-20260315-048 and rca-doc.
